reviews.author: C. H.
reviews.text:
We would not rent from this provider again, nor would we recommend it to others. We rented a car through Check24/AddCar (Naxos). Upon return, we were charged an additional €580 for alleged bodywork damage (rear bumper, trunk plastic trim, taillight), separate from the deposit.

During the return, the situation escalated: the person handling the return raised her voice and shouted repeatedly during the discussion about the damage. She then called the police herself. Once officers arrived, she continued to speak loudly and dominated the conversation, giving the officers little opportunity to ask us questions directly. In our experience, this made it very difficult to calmly clarify the facts of the situation.

Having since read other reviews describing similar experiences — unexpected damage charges raised at return, with little opportunity to review or contest them calmly — this appears to be a recurring pattern with this rental provider.

We had an excellent experience with Fast Motor Rentals from start to finish. Ria and Marios run an amazing family-owned business, and you can immediately tell they genuinely care about their customers.

Returning the car was just as smooth as picking it up. We simply met them back at the port, handed over the keys, and were on our way within minutes.

If you’re visiting Naxos and want a rental company that’s honest, reliable, and easy to work with, I can’t recommend Fast Motor Rentals enough. Supporting a wonderful family-owned business like this made our trip even better. Thank you, Ria and Marios, for making everything so easy!

reviews.author: Jacquelyn Jones
reviews.text:
Rent with caution ⚠️  Intimidation tactics and verbal aggression

Everything was fine at pick up, no issues with the car, etc. Unfortunately, while following GPS we were taken down a suddenly very narrow street the night before dropping off. As a result the car was scratched on one of the side mirrors, the plastic fender, and one of the rims, but all cosmetic damage. We were completely aware that we would be responsible for the damages and my husband immediately pointed out what happened to the couple that owns it at drop off. They immediately became very upset and verbally aggressive. Despite the fact that the rental contract required a 2,000 euro deposit in case of damages anyway they demanded my husband go with them to their mechanic immediately. They weren’t going to let us walk away and we had to catch a ferry soon so ultimately my husband had to give in to their demands. Every time he asked why the deposit could not just be forfeited they would only reply that it wouldn’t be enough to cover the damages even though it hadn’t been assessed yet.

While at the mechanic, they made my husband swipe his card four times in different amounts under threat of calling the cops if he didn’t. He again had no choice but to give in. Somehow, these charges added up to about the same 2,000 that they swore repeatedly wouldn’t be enough to cover the damages. They then did bring him back to the port and tried to be nicer but at that point there was no improving the situation.

At the very least, this is very shady and inappropriate business practice. Rental cars inherently run a risk of acquiring damage and situations where that occurs should require no intimidation. It is also NEVER OK to force a tourist to get into a car with strangers and drive to an unknown location in a foreign country. If you’re unable to handle these situations appropriately then find a new business to go into.

When returning the car, I was also asked to pay €50 for scratches on the paintwork for which I was supposedly responsible. (This was absolutely not the case.)
The €50 isn't the problem covered by my insurance, but the way these people rip you off right in front of you is.
In my opinion, Fast Motor Rental is an unprofessional and unreliable company. Fortunately, there are also reputable rental companies on the island.
You've been warned. FMR, don't do it!!!!!

reviews.author: Xcaret RG
reviews.text:
⚠ Warning about Fast Motor Rental Naxos/ AddCar

At first, everything seemed wonderful. The staff was very friendly and helpful when I rented the car, and the service looked great.

However, after returning the car, they called me saying I had to pay €50 because of some “glue” they claimed was on the pedal. Later, they added more supposed issues — floor mats, scratches, and other things that were never mentioned during the return inspection.

But the worst part was what happened next. The owner, Ria, and her husband showed up at the restaurant where I was having breakfast by the beach. They had my personal information from the rental agreement and came demanding the €50 in person.

Ria raised her voice, made me feel harassed, and even said she had “contacts” who could make it difficult for me to leave the island if I didn’t pay. I ended up paying just to end the situation.

This wasn’t about the €50. It felt like a tactic to intimidate tourists into paying extra money after the rental.

My advice to anyone renting from this company:
•	Take a detailed video of the car (inside, outside, pedals, mats, everything) before driving away.
•	Make sure the contract name matches the actual company.
•	Don’t let anyone pressure or threaten you.

They seemed kind at the beginning, but my experience turned into a very stressful and unpleasant situation. I strongly recommend being extremely cautious if you choose to rent from them.

reviews.author: John Stewart, Jr.
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of renting a car from Fast Motor Rental Naxos during my recent trip to Naxos, and I can't praise their service enough. From the moment we arrived, Ria and Marios went above and beyond to make our experience exceptional. They delivered and picked up the car right at our hotel, which was incredibly convenient.

Their professionalism and friendliness truly stood out. They provided us with valuable insights on exploring Naxos, recommending the best routes and fantastic dining spots. This local knowledge enhanced our trip immensely.

Not only was the service outstanding, but the rental rate was also excellent. The cars were spotlessly clean and appeared brand new, giving us peace of mind as we embarked on our adventures around the island.

Fast Motor Rental Naxos exceeded our expectations in every way, making our visit to Naxos all the more memorable. If you're in need of a rental car in Naxos, I highly recommend them for their top-notch service, friendly approach, and commitment to ensuring a fantastic experience. Thank you, Ria and Marios, for making our trip so enjoyable!
